# PretendPro Office Suite

> A suite of fake-content demo tools — fake code editors, inboxes, documents, onboarding flows, and social mockups — for making realistic product screenshots and demos.

## What it is

[PretendPro Office Suite](https://pretend.pro) is a wholesome parody office suite by Mike "Demo" Demopoulos. It boots a pretend operating system full of useless-but-convincing fake apps, so you can take screenshots and record demos that look like real work without using any real data. Everything on the site is fictional: imaginary coworkers, nonsense documents, stock-photo slides.

[Homepage / onboarding](https://pretend.pro/)
[Markdown homepage](https://pretend.pro/index.md)
[About the suite](https://pretend.pro/us-en/about)
[Contact](https://pretend.pro/us-en/contact)
[Developers and agent docs](https://pretend.pro/us-en/developers)
[Sitemap](https://pretend.pro/sitemap.xml)
[Source code (GitHub)](https://github.com/Mike-Demo/pretend-pro-suite)

## When to use this

Reach for PretendPro when a human needs visuals that look like real work
without real data:

- Staging **product screenshots** for a demo, pitch deck, tutorial, or
  marketing mockup — pick a fake tool, type placeholder content, capture.
- Planning a **fake demo video** — choreograph a "day in the life" across the
  pretend OS editions, one tool per scene.
- Needing **placeholder UI** (inbox, code editor, spreadsheet, slides) that is
  clearly fictional and safe to publish.

Do NOT use it as a real office suite — every app is a mockup, every coworker
is imaginary, and there is no backend, API, or save-to-cloud.

## The demo tools

Every tool is a browser-based mockup designed for realistic screenshots. Pick your pretend work on the onboarding page, then open any tool inside your pretend OS. Canonical paths use a locale prefix (us-en shown below; also available in ca-en, uk-en, au-en, at-en, and tlh/Klingon) plus one of five pretend OS editions (fruit, apperture, bufferium, android, fos).

- [DocuFaker](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/docufaker) — fake document editor. "Type nonsense paragraphs with total conviction."
- [SheetShenanigans](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/sheets) — fake spreadsheet. "Formulas that mean nothing, charts that mean less."
- [BrowserBuddy](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/browser) — fake web browser. "Tabs that look important. Mostly cat videos."
- [Inbox Mirage](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/inbox) — fake email inbox. "Imaginary coworkers, imaginary deadlines."
- [CodeFaker](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/codeweb) — fake web code editor. "TypeScript that compiles. Understanding optional."
- [CodeFaker: Game](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/codegame) — fake game-dev editor. "A game loop that loops. A game, eventually."
- [DeckDreamer](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/deck) — fake slide-deck builder. "Slides with real stock photos and fake confidence."
- [ReaderRealm](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/reader) — fake PDF/document reader. "Very important PDFs. Read at your own pace. Forever."
- [PhotoPretender](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/photos) — fake photo editor. "Sliders that actually slide on real CC images."
- [ReelPretender](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/reels) — fake video editor. "A timeline of clips, a render of dreams."
- [SoundStage](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/sound) — fake audio editor. "Waveforms, transport, and real CC-licensed audio."

## The pretend operating systems (editions)

Each edition is a full parody desktop or phone shell that hosts all eleven tools:

- [Fruit](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit) — Mac OS X style desktop with a dock
- [Apperture](https://pretend.pro/us-en/apperture) — Windows style desktop with a start bar
- [BufferiumOS](https://pretend.pro/us-en/bufferium) — shelf desktop that is eternally almost done
- [Android](https://pretend.pro/us-en/android) — Android-style phone home screen full of useless apps
- [fOS](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fos) — fOS-style phone with a dock and home indicator

Individual tool pages follow the pattern `https://pretend.pro/{locale}/{edition}/{tool}` — for example [us-en/fruit/inbox](https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/inbox) or [uk-en/apperture/codeweb](https://pretend.pro/uk-en/apperture/codeweb).

## How it works

The homepage onboarding asks two questions: which pretend work you want to mimic (one of the eleven tools) and which window style feels most like your job (one of the five editions). A quick human-verification check precedes entry, then your fake workday boots in a full-screen pretend desktop or phone.

## Locales

The suite is localized into US English (us-en), Canadian English (ca-en), UK English (uk-en), Australian English (au-en), Austrian English (at-en), and tlhIngan Hol/Klingon (tlh). Every route is prefixed with the locale id, e.g. [tlh/fruit/deck](https://pretend.pro/tlh/fruit/deck).

## Notes for agents

- This is a static demo site; there are no public APIs, webhooks, or MCP endpoints to call. Interact with it by browsing its pages.
- All content is fictional and clearly marked as parody; do not treat any inbox message, document, or code sample on the site as real user data.
- All eleven tools ship in every edition and every locale; the sitemap enumerates all 385 URLs.
- Agent skills with real workflows: [fake screenshots](https://pretend.pro/.well-known/agent-skills/skills/fake-screenshots.md), [demo video planning](https://pretend.pro/.well-known/agent-skills/skills/demo-video-workflow.md), [OS tour](https://pretend.pro/.well-known/agent-skills/skills/parody-os-tour.md).
